name: LA Street Dogs — Bacon-Wrapped Hot Dogs with Grilled Onions and Peppers
subtitle: Bacon-Wrapped Hot Dogs with Grilled Onions and Peppers
description: The Los Angeles "danger dog" from the carts outside concerts and ballgames: bacon-wrapped franks griddled crisp, piled with onions and peppers cooked in the bacon fat, mayo, ketchup, mustard and a charred whole jalapeño. Serves 4 (8 dogs).

steps.text: Wrap each of 8 all-beef hot dogs in a slice of 8 slices thin-cut bacon in a tight spiral, tucking or pinning the ends with toothpicks.
Heat a griddle or large cast-iron pan over medium. Cook the dogs seam side down first, turning, for 10 minutes, until the bacon is crisp all over.

Push the dogs to the side and cook 1 large white onion, sliced, 1 green bell pepper, sliced and 1/4 tsp salt in the rendered bacon fat for 10 minutes, stirring, until soft and charred in spots. At the same time, char 8 jalapeños whole for 8 minutes, turning.
Warm 8 soft hot dog buns on the griddle for 1 minute. Mix 1 tomato, finely diced, 1/4 white onion, finely diced and 2 tbsp chopped cilantro for a quick pico.

Spread the buns with 4 tbsp mayonnaise, add a dog, pile on onions and peppers, then zigzag 4 tbsp ketchup and 4 tbsp yellow mustard on top and spoon on the pico. Serve each with a charred jalapeño on the side.

notes: Thin bacon crisps in the same time it takes the hot dog to heat through; thick bacon stays flabby. Remove the toothpicks before serving. Bolillo rolls are the other popular bun.
